notes: FirstSeen Desktop V10.3.5 fixes the Remove Client → Lead button for accidental client conversions. V10.3.4 used a transaction helper that Node's built-in SQLite DatabaseSync does not provide, so the rollback failed. V10.3.5 uses explicit SQLite BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK, keeps the original CRM lead, removes only the accidental Client conversion, restores the lead's pre-Won stage from its timeline where possible, and immediately opens Leads after success. Errors such as linked payment/schedule data are now shown visibly instead of making the button appear unresponsive. Existing Supabase lead sync, Browser CRM V4.3, messaging, Twilio, Finder, websites and updater behaviour are preserved.
